0022600211.text: The New York Knicks (5-4, on a three-game winning streak and 3-2 at home) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-8, on a five-game losing streak) in the Knicks' 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with New York 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 5th in the East, while Milwaukee is 5th in the Central, 5.5 games back, and 15th in the East. Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for the Knicks, and no Bucks players are listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
